articles.summary: OP Bancorp (the “Company”) (Nasdaq; OPBK), the parent company of Open Bank (the “Bank”), announced today that it has completed a private placement of $25 million principal amount of fixed-to-floating rate subordinated note due 2035 (the “Note”) on November 7, 2025 pursuant to a subordinated note purchase agreement in a private placement (the “Agreement”). The Note was issued in a private placement without registration under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the “Securities Act”), relying on exemptions under Section 4(a)(2) of the Securities Act. The Note will mature on November 15, 2035. articles.title: OP Bancorp Announces Closing of $25 million of 7.50% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Subordinated Note
